kicker.zh: 本地优先 · 个人创作 AI

sub.zh: 说话代替打字，整理交给 AI，数据永远留在你的机器。
sub.en: Talk instead of type. AI does the organizing. Your data stays on your machine.

guard.zh: 现在能用上的是它的记忆底座：说一句话，它替你记好、整理好、在你写东西时找回来。
guard.en: What works today is its memory core: say a line, and it files it, organizes it, and surfaces it when you write.

formph.zh: 留下邮箱，发布时通知你
formph.en: Leave your email — we'll notify you at launch

formq.zh: 现在最挡着你的一件事是什么？（选填）
formq.en: What blocks you the most today? (optional)

formerr.zh: 请填写一个可用的邮箱地址。
formerr.en: Please enter a valid email address.

formok.zh: 已加入内测等待名单，发布时第一时间通知你。
formok.en: You're on the waitlist — we'll notify you first at launch.

formnote.zh: 仅用于内测通知 · 不用于营销 · 可随时退订
formnote.en: Beta notices only · no marketing · unsubscribe anytime

cardhint.zh: 卡片由这条记录直接生成 · 可改写 · 可撤回
cardhint.en: Card generated from this entry · editable · revocable
